metadata.title: Loop Fundamental Quandles: A Geometric Generalization of the Knot Quandle
metadata.abstract: The knot quandle, introduced independently by Joyce and Matveev, admits a geometric description in terms of nooses. Motivated by this description, we introduce the \textit{loop fundamental quandle} $LQ(X,A,\ast)$ of a pair $(X,A)$ with a fixed base point $\ast\in X$. Its elements are represented by pairs consisting of a loop in $A$ and a path joining the base point of the loop to the fixed base point $\ast$. More generally, for a loop condition $P$ on $A$, invariant under free homotopy, we define the loop fundamental quandle $LQ(X,A,\ast;P)$. We establish functoriality and homotopy invariance of the loop fundamental quandle and show that it admits a natural augmented quandle structure over $\pi_1(X,\ast)$. For a knot $K$ in $S^3$, applying the construction to its exterior gives the \textit{knot loop quandle} $LQ(K,\ast;P)$. Appropriate choices of the loop condition recover the knot quandle, its $n$-th power quandles, and the full knot quandle. The construction is inspired by Joyce's noose-theoretic approach, but allows loop data that need not arise as the boundary of a disk satisfying the noose condition.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 环路基本 quandle 框架
analysis.workSummary: 定义空间对 (X,A) 的环路基本 quandle，以 A 中环路及其到固定基点的路径为元素，并允许自由同伦不变的环路条件。证明函子性、同伦不变性与 π₁ 增广结构，应用到结外部可统一恢复结 quandle、其幂及 full quandle。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 noose 描述扩展到不必来自可容许圆盘边界的环路数据。
analysis.limitations: 恢复已有结不变量需选取相应环路条件；未宣称新结构完整分类所有结。
analysis.priorityReason: 经典结 quandle 的几何统一与推广。
